assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology, incretin biology and the resulting therapies have transformed treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity, with large cardiovascular and renal outcome benefits. Clear chain from basic hormone biology to a medicine used by millions; impact is exceptional and still expanding.
assessment.attribution: Drucker (GLP-1 biology, proglucagon processing and GLP-2), Holst (physiology and incretin effect in humans) and Mojsov (peptide chemistry identifying the active GLP-1 form) form a plausible trio. Knudsen's industrial development of liraglutide/semaglutide is a fourth claimant, and Mojsov's credit relative to others in the field is debated.
assessment.maturity: Mechanism confirmed independently for decades and validated in large randomised trials; recognition is timely given the public-health weight of the drugs.
uncertainties: Credit split among academic discoverers and industrial developers is contested.
Long-term safety and outcome data for the newest agents are still accumulating.
I rely on my own recollection of the literature and have not independently verified priority claims.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetically engineered T cells directed by chimeric antigen receptors produce durable remissions in refractory B-cell malignancies and have opened a new class of living drugs. Concept is original and the clinical effect is striking.
assessment.attribution: June (clinical translation of CD19 CAR-T with 4-1BB costimulation) and Sadelain (CD28-costimulated second-generation CARs and preclinical proof) are the core pair. Rosenberg's earlier adoptive cell therapy work is foundational but arguably a distinct discovery; Eshhar, who first described the chimeric receptor concept, is absent from the supplied credit.
assessment.maturity: Multiple approved products and years of follow-up confirm durable responses in leukaemia and lymphoma; timely, though solid-tumour efficacy remains limited.
uncertainties: Credit omits Zelig Eshhar and others in the supplied names, complicating a fair configuration.
Toxicity (cytokine release, neurotoxicity) and secondary malignancy concerns persist.
Whether Rosenberg's work should be recognised separately is unresolved.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetics gave neuroscience and physiology causal, cell-type-specific control of activity with light, reshaping experimental design across the field and beginning to enter vision restoration. Methodological impact is vast and the discovery of channelrhodopsins is a clean, original starting point.
assessment.attribution: Nagel and Hegemann identified channelrhodopsin function; Deisseroth (and Boyden) demonstrated neuronal use and developed the toolkit. Bamberg and Miesenboeck contributed key early steps, so six credited names exceed the three-laureate limit and any trio leaves a legitimate contributor out.
assessment.maturity: Widely and independently reproduced for over fifteen years; timing is mature, with early clinical translation adding weight.
uncertainties: Allocation among six contributors is highly contested.
Clinical impact is so far limited relative to research impact.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Antisense modulation of SMN2 splicing (nusinersen) turned spinal muscular atrophy, a lethal infantile disease, into a treatable condition and validated splice-switching oligonucleotides as a drug class. Outstanding mechanism-to-medicine story.
assessment.attribution: Krainer defined the splicing mechanism and target sequences, and Bennett led oligonucleotide chemistry and drug development at Ionis; the pair maps well onto the discovery and its translation. Other Ionis and academic collaborators are not in the supplied credit.
assessment.maturity: Approved since 2016, with long-term follow-up and independent confirmation of benefit; mature and timely.
uncertainties: Role of other collaborators (e.g., gene-replacement alternatives and other splicing work) is not captured in the supplied credit.
Long-term durability data are still developing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Showing that TNF is a therapeutic target in rheumatoid arthritis led to anti-TNF biologics that revolutionised treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, Crohn's disease and psoriasis. Concept, clinical proof and global impact are all well established.
assessment.attribution: Feldmann and Maini conducted the key mechanistic and clinical proof-of-concept work and form a natural pair. Contributions of antibody developers and the original TNF cloning groups are separate and could complicate scope.
assessment.maturity: Decades of clinical use and independent confirmation; recognition is, if anything, overdue, and the Lasker 2003 precedent supports maturity.
uncertainties: Whether the prize would be seen as clinically focused on a single pathway rather than a fundamental discovery.
Credit relative to TNF cloning and antibody engineering groups is not settled.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The unfolded protein response defined a new mode of intracellular signalling from the ER to the nucleus, with major relevance for secretory physiology, diabetes, neurodegeneration and cancer. Fundamental, original and conceptually clean.
assessment.attribution: Walter and Mori independently elucidated the IRE1-HAC1/XBP1 pathway; the pairing is well supported. Other contributors (e.g., Ron, Kaufman, Walter's collaborators) may not be fully represented.
assessment.maturity: Mechanism confirmed in yeast and mammals over thirty years; recognition has been repeatedly prefigured by major prizes. Therapeutic translation is still early.
uncertainties: Therapeutic impact on disease remains largely preclinical or early clinical.
David Ron and Randal Kaufman are not in the credited names, so some relevant credit may be unrepresented.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like particle HPV vaccines prevent infection and are producing striking falls in cervical precancer and cancer, a rare case of cancer prevention by vaccination. Nobel worthiness is high on public-health impact, though zur Hausen's 2008 prize covered the causal link.
assessment.attribution: Lowy and Schiller (NCI) developed L1 VLPs and Frazer (with Zhou) contributed the VLP work; Jian Zhou's early death and the commercial parallel development by others complicate the attribution picture.
assessment.maturity: Population-level effectiveness data from several countries now provide strong, independent confirmation; timely.
uncertainties: Overlap with an already honoured HPV-cancer prize may reduce novelty in the committee's view.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BCR-ABL inhibition by imatinib created the paradigm of molecularly targeted cancer therapy and transformed CML into a chronic disease. Lasting influence on oncology drug development is large.
assessment.attribution: Lydon (compound development), Druker (clinical translation) and Sawyers (resistance mechanisms and second-generation inhibitors) form a plausible trio, although Sawyers' contribution is on resistance rather than the original drug. Contributions from Rowley and Nowell are earlier discoveries of the Philadelphia chromosome and not in the supplied credit.
assessment.maturity: Over twenty years of confirmation with durable survival benefit; mature, and arguably the recognition window is already late.
uncertainties: Whether the field's earlier genetic discoveries should anchor the prize instead of the drug.
Rowley and others are not included in the supplied credit.
